customManagers.description: Track the version of docker-mediawiki-tools pinned as MEDIAWIKI_TOOLS_VERSION in the Dockerfile, which Renovate's built-in managers do not detect.

Track the Xdebug version pinned as XDEBUG_VERSION in the Dockerfile. One version for all PHP versions: Xdebug 3.5 supports PHP 8.2 to 8.5. The upstream tags also contain old XDEBUG_x_y_z and RC tags, only stable 3.x releases are taken.

packageRules.description: The base image is resolved by the workflow (MediaWiki version and digest), the ARG defaults in the Dockerfile are only a fallback.
